**DK28.0** is a medical diagnosis code representing an acute gastrointestinal ulcer with bleeding ("akut gastrointestinalt sår med blødning"). Within the Danish healthcare system, this code is utilized as part of the clinical quality indicators for patients with [[atrieflimren|atrieflimren]], coordinated by the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP) [^src1] [^src2]. 

Specifically, DK28.0 is one of several codes used to measure the incidence of severe bleeding events among atrial fibrillation patients [^src1]. The tracking of gastrointestinal bleeding relies on a range of codes including [[dk25-0|DK25.0]] through [[dk29-8a|DK29.8A]] (which includes DK28.0) and [[dk92-0|DK92.0]] through [[dk92-2|DK92.2]] [^src1]. This comprehensive bleeding indicator also incorporates codes for intracranial bleeding (such as [[di60|DI60]], [[di61|DI61]], [[di62|DI62]], [[ds064|DS064]], [[ds065|DS065]], and [[ds066|DS066]]) as well as urinary and respiratory tract bleeding (including [[dj942|DJ942]], [[dn02|DN02]], [[dr04|DR04]], and [[dr31|DR31]]) [^src1]. The precise definition and application of DK28.0 and related codes are documented in the annual methodology reports for atrial fibrillation in Denmark, ensuring standardized data collection and quality comparison across regions [^src1] [^src2].

## Claims
- **Diagnostic**: For incidens af alvorlig blødning anvendes en bred vifte af diagnoser, herunder DI60–DS066 for intrakraniel blødning, DK25.0–DK29.8A og DK92.0–DK92.2 for gastrointestinal blødning samt DJ942, DN02, DR04 og DR31 for urinvejs-/lunge blødning [^src1] (di60, di61, di62, ds064, ds065, ds066, dk25-0, dk25-2, dk25-4, dk25-6, dk26-0, dk26-2, dk26-4, dk26-6, dk27-0, dk27-2, dk27-4, dk27-6, dk28-0, dk28-2, dk28-4, dk28-6, dk29-0, dk29-8a, dk92-0, dk92-1, dk92-2, dj942, dn02, dr04, dr31)
